basic_info.description: For the Buyer Who Wants It All: Style, Location & Smart Value Step into sunshine & simplicity with this charming Mission District studio. Tucked away in one of San Franciscos most vibrant & dynamic neighborhoods, this home puts you just blocks from the buzz of Valencia Street where trendsetting restaurants, artisan coffee shops, indie music venues, & unique local boutiques create an unbeatable city vibe. Visit Dolores Park for weekend lounging, stock up at Whole Foods, explore the Castro & tap into everything the Mission has to offer. Commuters rejoice-tech shuttle stops are nearby You are backed by a stellar Walk Score of 98. What You will Love: Your own private patio is a peaceful retreat from the citys energy Spacious walk-in closet & clever floor plan that maximizes space & style Deeded garage parking with extra storage (a rare find!) Bicycle room for two-wheeled commuters Access to a gym, sauna, guest parking, & lush greenbelt gardens Affordable HOA dues that cover earthquake insurance, reserves, water, sewer, garbage, & more. Whether you are a first-time buyer, investor, or looking for a city pied-à-terre, this is easily one of the smartest buys in San Francisco today. Be sure not to see this great opportunity!
